entry.title: New: dsh-rules-manager
entry.summary: Rules, commands & skills manager for dsh: /rules slash command, settings panel with visual rule editing (add/edit/disable/delete, free-zone support), user-defined custom commands with {input} arguments, skill management, and automatic backup & one-click restore of AGENTS.md. Exact install spec: github:jilian-dsh/dsh-rules-manager. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
